I'm checking whether the phrase "early-onset breast and ovarian cancer" counts as a composite mention, since it names two separate cancers joined by "and". Under the guideline, a phrase like "colorectal, endometrial, and ovarian cancers" is composite, so this one likely is too, and I'm wondering whether the "early-onset" modifier belongs inside the annotation.

I'm weighing the remaining candidates: "breast and / or ovarian cancer" also reads as a composite mention, since it names two separate diseases. A generic "disease" I'll leave unannotated as a general term. For "tumour suppressor model," the word refers to a gene or protein function rather than a disease, so I lean toward no annotation there.
